verify_model_files: verify model files against a checksums JSON file or HuggingFace repo ID using SHA256 hashes
generate_checksums: generate a checksums.json file for a local model directory or HuggingFace repo ID
load_manifest_from_dict: load a Manifest from a dictionary supporting both deprecated checksums and new files format
serialize_manifest_to_dict: serialize a Manifest object to a dictionary with files and FileInfo dataclasses
compute_sha256: compute the SHA256 hash of a file by reading it in 64KB chunks
